## A section heading

For a post with R code, add a chunk like the one below. When you click Render in RStudio, the code runs and its output and plots appear in the post. Set the category to `code`.

```{r}
#| eval: false
summary(cars)
plot(cars)
```

Delete `#| eval: false` to run the chunk for real, and delete `draft: true` above when the post is ready.
